name: FIM-92 Stinger (M-SHORAD / MADIS)
description: IR-homing SHORAD missile on the M-SHORAD RIwP and MADIS Mk1 turrets. FIM-92J/K proximity fuze added for small UAS. 4.8 km weapon max; 4-round pod.

minRangeM.condition: minimum engagement range — quoted minimum effective range for the FIM-92 family; not variant-specific
minRangeM.source: Raytheon (General Dynamics) FIM-92 Stinger — Directory of U.S. Military Rockets and Missiles

maxRangeM.condition: outward targeting range up to 4800 m

engageTimeS.condition: assignment-to-effect time — DERIVED, not published. Arithmetic: Stinger flyout is quoted at Mach 2.2+ (about 750 m/s); 4,800 m / 750 m/s = 6.4 s time of flight. Add roughly 8 s for seeker cool-down, IR lock tone and launch sequence: 6.4 + 8 = 14.4 s, rounded to 15 s. No public assignment-to-effect figure exists.
engageTimeS.source: Raytheon (General Dynamics) FIM-92 Stinger — Directory of U.S. Military Rockets and Missiles

pk.condition: 0.7 (PF); 2 of 2 intercepts, 2017 Army test (two trials, so no spread)
pk.source: RTX, Stinger page (rtx.com, integrated air and missile defense, Stinger missile)

magazineSize.condition: ready rounds on the launcher — MADIS Mk1 turret carries a four-round Stinger ATAL pod; the Stryker M-SHORAD RIwP turret carries four Stingers. Reload is a manual crew task off the turret; reload time is not public.
magazineSize.source: MADIS Marine Air Defense Integrated System

salvoCooldownS.condition: salvo cooldown — no public figure; representative turret re-slew and next-round tone time

seekerAcquisitionRangeM.note: Planning factor: the cooled conical-scan IR seeker locks on before launch, so acquisition is bounded by the 4.8 km maximum engagement range of the weapon, which this file carries as maxRangeM. No lock-on range is published.

lethalRadiusM.note: Class median of the one sourced interceptor warhead radius: the APKWS M151 burst radius of 10 m (lib-eagls). The 3 kg Stinger blast-fragmentation warhead is the closest in the set to the 3.95 kg M151. No lethal radius is published for the FIM-92. A one-member median is thin; it is recorded as such so a later source replaces it cleanly.

guidanceNoiseM.note: Planning factor: 2 m 1 sigma terminal guidance noise for a proximity-fuzed interceptor. The one sourced member of the class, the semi-active laser APKWS at better than 1 m CEP, sits at the accurate end; this seeker's accuracy is not published.

maxFlyoutSpeedMps.condition: top speed at motor burnout reported as high as Mach 2.6, taken at a sea-level Mach 1 of 340 m/s; flyoutSpeedMps keeps the Mach 2.2 figure of 750 m/s

boostTimeS.condition: the boost phase accelerates the missile to Mach 2.2 within 2 s
